name: DIB-R Rendering Models
definition: A framework supporting basic rendering (vertex colors or texture maps) and local illumination models (Phong, Lambertian, Spherical Harmonics) where pixel values are determined by interpolating abstract vertex attributes.
summary: DIB-R is a differentiable rendering framework that interpolates diverse vertex attributes to enable gradient back-propagation through complex lighting models, unlike standard renderers that only support color or opacity interpolation.
